body: I'm investigating this with a pull request soon.
Make sure you install the latest Mesa NIR (re run the install script).
Yes, did you run this script recently? We've updated Mesa last week.

I don't seem to reproduce the issue cross-compiling from Linux to Windows with https://github.com/mstorsjo/llvm-mingw/releases/download/20251216/llvm-mingw-20251216-ucrt-ubuntu-22.04-x86_64.tar.xz and the latest Mesa version after running `python misc/scripts/install_d3d12_sdk_windows.py`.

Might also be worth double checking that this script properly overwrites existing files in `AppData\Local\Godot\build_deps`. It works for me on Linux (where it's installed in `bin/build_deps`) but I haven't tried recently on Windows.

I discovered that the download script was timing out.
